name: Plan and launch online e-commerce stores
description: Users asked for guidance on establishing and operating online retail businesses, including requests for specific business plans, platform setup instructions, product selection, and explanations of e-commerce fees and features. The requests covered a wide range of activities, from starting dropshipping and handmade goods stores to analyzing domain investments and navigating cross-border trade logistics.
